stories.topic: US / CHINA / SINGAPORE / AMD / SEMICONDUCTORS / EXPORT CONTROLS
stories.headline: AMD falls after disputed Hunterbrook allegations about China-linked server firmware
stories.body: Reuters reported AMD shares down 8% on 19 November after Hunterbrook Media alleged newer AMD firmware appeared in servers from blacklisted IEIT Systems and related suppliers, including Singapore-based Kaytus. Hunterbrook Capital disclosed a short position in AMD. Reuters could not independently verify the allegations. AMD disputed the account, saying it misrepresented its practices and relationships and that the company complies with applicable US export-control rules. The share move is a historical Reuters observation with no individually verified quote clock, not a closing-price or regulatory-finding claim.
stories.analysis: An allegation by an interested short seller is distinct from a proven export-control breach. Independent findings and the company response matter for valuation risk.
stories.watch_next: AMD disclosures and any actual Commerce Department action. No breach is presumed.

stories.topic: CANADA / CHINA / PBOC / CNY / PANDA BONDS / BANK FUNDING
stories.headline: National Bank of Canada plans regular panda funding after a CNY15bn programme approval
stories.body: A National Bank of Canada executive told Reuters it could issue up to CNY15 billion of Chinese onshore panda bonds in 2027 and intends to become a regular issuer. He said the PBoC had most recently approved a CNY15 billion programme. Reuters gave an approximate US$2.25 billion equivalent; this is a source conversion, not a new executable FX quote. The programme approval and potential funding amount do not establish a completed bond sale. No coupon, issuance yield, market yield, maturity or attributable currency move was verified.
stories.analysis: Access to another funding market may diversify borrowing, while actual terms, credit spreads and currency management determine its economics.
stories.watch_next: Confirmed issue dates, pricing, tenors and use of proceeds.
